text_block_list.text:
While in the middle of a meeting with 
Eishin Flash—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. I've had a headache since this 
morning...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes, there is no need to worry...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I took the medicine 30 minutes ago, so it 
should start taking effect soon.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The pain is scheduled to subside by 17:00 
at the latest, so...

Despite what she said, the pain showed no 
signs of subsiding, and she was plagued by 
a headache for quite a while.
